title: Nightscout uploader causes HTTP error 413 - Payload Too Large when sending a large number of entries
symptom: Nightscout uploader sends bg readings using a JSON array in the request body, but it causes HTTP error 413 (Payload Too Large) when there are a lot of entries. A user trying to send all data for more than 2 years (more than 6000 entries) encountered this error.
fix: Workaround: export xDrip database, extract SQLite3 database, open it and delete all content from table UploaderQueue. Then send only 1 month of data to Nightscout, which worked. The suggestion is to send data in smaller batches.
evidence_quote: Workaround: I exported xDrip database, extracted SQLite3 database, opened it and deleted all content from table UploaderQueue. Then, we decided to send only 1 month of data to Nightscout and it worked.
